title: prunus persica subsp. platycarpa
intro: Prunus persica subsp. platycarpa, commonly known as the flat peach, is a variant of the peach tree characterized by its flat, elliptical shape. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been utilized for its health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels and reducing the risk of heart disease due to its high content of dietary fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of Prunus persica subsp. platycarpa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are commonly found in various plant-based remedies.
